name: applet
description: **Daily Brief** is an executive news briefing platform engineered with a **Node.js + Express backend** and a **Jetpack Compose Android app**. It automatically aggregates breaking news across six key verticals, summarizes each story into 3–5 high-impact bullet lines using the OpenAI API, stores briefings in SQLite, and synchronizes with an offline-first Android client with daily 8:00 AM push notifications.
